events.title: Login Resets
events.description: After rumors of a competitive site being compromised that may have exposed HF members with shared accounts, login session keys were reset, logging every user out of all devices as a precaution.

events.title: HF Hack Game Update
events.description: Brand-new shop items and elements were added to the HF Hack Game. Due to the update, the game was reset — all levels, game cash, and XP set to 0.

events.title: YasPresents purchased and renamed.
events.description: Dorrance purchased YasPresents and renamed it to Masterminds.
